summary: Outer generator throw during yield* forwards to inner throw when present.

semantics.forward: Call inner throw with thrown value

tests.name: throw forwarded to inner generator
tests.input: function* inner(){try{yield 1}catch(e){yield e}} function* outer(){yield* inner()} const it=outer();it.next();console.log(it.throw("x"));
tests.expected_behavior: result has value x done false

tests.name: inner throw completion value continues outer
tests.input: const inner={next(){return {value:1,done:false}},throw(){return {value:6,done:true}},[Symbol.iterator](){return this}};function* g(){return yield* inner}const it=g();it.next();console.log(it.throw("x"));
